blocks.text: Candy Pangilinan urged Patrick Garcia to give himself a chance to build a relationship with his son Jazz, following the actor’s recent statements about his past relationship with Jennylyn Mercado. Pangilinan shared her thoughts on the issue during the Oct. 4 episode of “Kalurks,” where she emphasized the importance of resolving personal matters privately before discussing them publicly. “Bago siguro siya nagsalita sa maraming tao, pinuntahan muna niya si Jennylyn at inayos niya na ito nang tahimik at privately.
